content.short: NuFi is a Web3 multichain wallet with broad hardware wallet compatibility across Ethereum, EVMs, Solana, SVMs, Cardano, and Flow.
content.description: NuFi is a Web3 multichain wallet that supports Ethereum, EVMs, Solana, SVMs, Cardano, and Flow, with Bitcoin coming soon. It enables seamless dApp connectivity and supports hardware wallets such as Ledger, Trezor, GridPlus, and BitBox, with more integrations planned. Accessible through a browser extension or web interface, NuFi offers a unified portfolio view to manage assets across multiple blockchains, balancing security with ease of use.
